$description: Sonnet Man design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens Community Group format (first stable version 2025.10). Read from src/styles/global.css and the classes the pages use at commit 0d6df6ef. Every token carries $extensions.com.inspiredmile.dossier.status: "as-built" (in the code), "as-built (unused)", or "proposed" (a recommendation in 10-ux-flows-and-design-system.md, not in the code). contrastOnObsidian950 is a WCAG 2 contrast ratio computed for this document against the page background #0d0b09; it was not measured in a browser. Draft for the team, 2026-11-19.

gold.$description: The gold ramp, defined in the @theme block of src/styles/global.css.

300.$description: Headline accent, the middle stop of text-gradient; the home card name.

400.$description: The primary accent: active navigation, form names, scores, ink, links on hover, btn-secondary text, Theatre accents.

500.$description: btn-primary fill; focus border at 50% on the verse box; borders at 20-40%.

obsidian.$description: The obsidian ramp, defined in the @theme block of src/styles/global.css.

300.$description: Navigation links, page intros, secondary text.

400.$description: Notes, quotes on cards, chip sub-lines. Lowest step that passes 4.5:1 on the page background.

500.$description: Small labels (uppercase field labels, craft so far, checklist detail). Fails 4.5:1 on the page (4.34) and on card-glass (4.12).

600.$description: Seed note under the duel, unmet checklist marker, mobile menu group labels. Fails 4.5:1 (3.26).

700.$description: Borders of panels, inputs and chips (2.43:1 on the page: below 3:1 for non-text contrast).

950.$description: Page background; manifest theme and background colour.

crimson.$description: The crimson ramp, defined in the @theme block of src/styles/global.css.

400.$description: ATK stat, sign-out hover, danger text.

500.$description: btn-danger fill; Live badge dot; curse notice at 10-30%.

tailwind-default.$description: Tailwind 4 default hues the game uses beside its own ramps (rarity, stats, checklist marks). Values read from tailwindcss 4.1.18 theme.css; the game locks tailwindcss 4.3.5, so confirm they are unchanged. hex is an sRGB conversion made for this document.

emerald-400.$description: Uncommon rarity text; HP stat; met checklist mark.

purple-400.$description: Epic rarity text; chosen relic or potion border (at 70%).

rarity.$description: Rarity pill colours: text colour on a translucent fill of the same hue (src/lib/cards.ts:731-737). Rarity is also written as a word on the pill, so it is not shown by colour alone.

common.$description: Common: text obsidian-400 on obsidian-700 at 50%. Pill contrast about 3.60:1 over card-glass (computed): below 4.5:1.

legendary.$description: Legendary: gold-400 on gold-500 at 20% (about 7.59:1, computed).

stat.$description: ATK, DEF and HP labels on character cards. The stats play no part in a duel (sources/as-built-design.md section 1.3).

glow.$description: Translucent gold used by glow-gold and pulse-glow.

semantic.$description: PROPOSED semantic layer (10-ux-flows-and-design-system.md). Not in the code: pages use the ramp steps directly. Each alias is chosen so that text passes 4.5:1 on surface.page and surface.panel.

panel.$description: Panels and inputs (card-glass is this at 60% over the page).

muted.$description: Smallest permitted text colour, replacing obsidian-500 and -600 wherever text is essential (5.44:1 on the page, 5.16:1 on card-glass).

on-accent.$description: Text on a gold fill (7.64:1 on gold-500).

control.$description: Borders that identify a control (inputs, chips, selects): obsidian-500 gives 4.34:1 on the page, above the 3:1 non-text minimum that obsidian-700 (2.43:1) misses.

ring.$description: A 2 px solid focus ring with a 2 px offset on every interactive element (10.27:1 on the page).

font.$description: Font families (src/styles/global.css:59-61; files in public/fonts, Latin and Latin-ext subsets only).

display.$description: Every heading, card names, verses (opponent verse and the verse box).

mono.$description: Card ids, round label, scores, seed.

unused.$description: Declared with @font-face and shipped (88,232 bytes of woff2), used by no class or token. Proposed: remove.

font-size.$description: Type sizes in use (Tailwind 4 defaults, 1 rem = 16 px). 10 px and 11 px arbitrary sizes also appear (card chip sub-line, checklist detail, mobile menu group label).

arbitrary-10px.$description: text-[10px]: card chip sub-line (device or curse) in the duel; mobile menu group labels.

proposed-minimum.$description: PROPOSED: the smallest text size on any page; replaces the 10 px and 11 px sizes.

letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing. Set to 0 for Arabic, Hindi and Thai pages (src/styles/global.css:131-139).

typography.$description: Composite text styles as the duel screen uses them.

page-title.$description: h1 on wide screens (text-4xl on phones, text-5xl from sm).

form-name.$description: The round's form name, in gold-400.

verse.$description: Opponent verse and the player's verse box.

space.$description: Spacing: Tailwind 4 multiplies one base unit (0.25 rem = 4 px).

unit.$description: The spacing base; p-4 is 4 units (1 rem).

header-height.$description: Fixed header; main content starts below it (pt-16).

target-minimum.$description: PROPOSED: the smallest hit area of any control (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8); 44 px preferred for the duel controls on phones.

sm.$description: rounded-sm: curse notice, opponent portrait, element tags.

2xl.$description: rounded-2xl: the home hero card, story scenes.

glow-gold.$description: Soft gold halo on the home hero card.

text-gold.$description: text-gradient: left-to-right gold on headline accents (clipped to the text).

motion.$description: Durations and easing. No prefers-reduced-motion rule exists anywhere in src (sources/as-built-design.md section 8).

base.$description: Buttons, chips, card hover zoom, progress bar.

float.$description: Looping float of the home card (infinite).

music-duck.$description: Music falls to 0.15 while the voice speaks.

feedback-max.$description: PROPOSED: the longest delay between an input and its visible confirmation (research/sota-design-2026-11.md section 4).

reduced.$description: PROPOSED: every looping or decorative animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

standard.$description: Tailwind ease-in-out and default transition timing.
